meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合姿态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做蛋白质-小分子对接或虚拟筛选研究
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on protein-ligand docking or virtual screening

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据蛋白质结构或序列，预测小分子配体的3D结合姿势，并给出置信度分数。支持单个或批量对接，以及虚拟筛选。
howto.when: 当你要求“预测结合姿势”、“运行分子对接”或“虚拟筛选”，并提供蛋白质PDB文件或序列以及配体SMILES/SDF/MOL2时触发。

say.text: 用这个CSV文件进行批量虚拟筛选：batch_input.csv。
say.note: Claude会读取CSV，对每个蛋白质-配体对执行对接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can predict 3D binding poses of small molecule ligands to protein targets using PDB files or sequences, output confidence scores, and handle single or batch docking and virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'predict binding pose', 'run molecular docking', or 'virtual screening', and provide a protein PDB file or sequence along with ligand SMILES/SDF/MOL2.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to the protein: ligand SMILES is CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O, protein PDB is protein.pdb.
say_en.note: Claude runs single docking and outputs top-ranked poses.

say_en.text: Run batch virtual screening using this CSV: batch_input.csv.
say_en.note: Claude reads the CSV and docks each protein-ligand pair.
